info.name: Midjourney Image Generation Image Analysis Jobs API
Get the status and results of a job

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier of the image generation job.

items.docs: Retrieves the current status, progress, and results of an asynchronous image generation job. Returns the job metadata including status, progress percentage, and when complete, the URLs of the generated images. Poll this endpoint to track job progress when webhooks are not configured.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter jobs by their current status.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of jobs to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of jobs to skip for pagination.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order for the returned jobs.

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of image generation jobs for the authenticated account. Jobs can be filtered by status and sorted by creation date. Returns job metadata including status, prompts, and result URLs for completed jobs.

info.name: Cancel a pending or in-progress job

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier of the image generation job.

items.docs: Cancels a job that is currently pending or in progress. Jobs that have already completed or failed cannot be cancelled. Cancelled jobs do not consume generation credits.
